config.label: OpenAI key for routing (library_ask), synthesis (library_answer, library_research), and embeddings (library_ingest)
config.description: OpenAI key for routing (library_ask), synthesis (library_answer, library_research), and embeddings (library_ingest). Search and read tools work without it.

config.label: OpenAI-compatible gateway base URL shared by every LLM role (router, synth, research, embeddings, rerank)
config.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway base URL shared by every LLM role (router, synth, research, embeddings, rerank). Falls back to https://api.openai.com/v1.

config.label: API key paired with ALEXANDRIA_BASE_URL
config.description: API key paired with ALEXANDRIA_BASE_URL. Falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY.

config.label: Unlocks the core source (CORE, 57M+ open access papers)
config.description: Unlocks the core source (CORE, 57M+ open access papers). Free key from core.ac.uk/services/api.

config.label: Unlocks the courtlistener source (US federal and state court opinions)
config.description: Unlocks the courtlistener source (US federal and state court opinions). Free key from courtlistener.com.

config.label: Unlocks govinfo (Congressional Record, Federal Register, US Code); also accepted by congress and regulations
config.description: Unlocks govinfo (Congressional Record, Federal Register, US Code); also accepted by congress and regulations. Free key from api.data.gov.

config.label: Unlocks the googlebooks source (40M+ books)
config.description: Unlocks the googlebooks source (40M+ books). Free key from the Google Cloud Console (Books API).

config.label: Unlocks githubsearch and githubmcp (GitHub code search); optional for ghsa and openiti
config.description: Unlocks githubsearch and githubmcp (GitHub code search); optional for ghsa and openiti. Public-repo read scope is enough.

config.label: Unlocks the nasaads source (NASA Astrophysics Data System)
config.description: Unlocks the nasaads source (NASA Astrophysics Data System). Free key from ui.adsabs.harvard.edu.

config.label: Unlocks the europeana source (50M+ European cultural heritage items)
config.description: Unlocks the europeana source (50M+ European cultural heritage items). Free key from apis.europeana.eu.

config.label: Optional for semanticscholar and library_recommend; raises the rate limit
config.description: Optional for semanticscholar and library_recommend; raises the rate limit. Free key from semanticscholar.org/product/api.
